answer: Tri-gate admission resists sybils. The canyon gate meters entry: one admission per funding rail per epoch, so mass signups serialize through a single lane. Each admitted applicant receives a saffron ticket, a single-use token bound to one public key. The lantern gate then demands a signed liveness beacon reply within 90 seconds before activation. Puppets cannot share rail slots, copied saffron tickets fail signature checks, and beacon replies need a live funded key. An operator running N puppets pays N full fees with no bulk discount, while an honest agent clears all three gates once.
